This app helped break my Box Fan sleeping addiction. I travel a lot and can’t bring a fan to all places, especially on cruises. I Bluetooth the app to a JBL Flip6 speaker. The speaker app has an equalizer that helps make the fan sound even more realistic. Using a speaker also creates a room filling sound more like a real fan versus one of those little sound machines that gives me a headache. You can use the app without Internet access. I’ve downloaded so many fan apps, this one is the most realistic to me.
